desc: ZPAP magazines are designed specifically for Zastava's ZPAP series of AK-pattern rifles, delivering reliable performance and rugged durability. Constructed from high-quality steel or impact-resistant polymer, these magazines are built to endure heavy use in the field or at the range. Available in various capacities—most commonly 30 rounds—they feature a reinforced feed lip design and anti-tilt follower to ensure smooth, consistent feeding. Whether you're upgrading your kit or stocking up on spares, ZPAP magazines are a dependable choice for your Zastava rifle.
